luxurious.en: This was not luxurious food. Hunger and starvation were actually serious risks for people across Britain, across Europe at the time.
luxurious.zh: 这不是奢侈的食物。在当时，饥饿和饥荒实际上是全英国、全欧洲人们面临的严重风险。

luxury.en: Sugar was considered such a luxury that they added it to savory dishes such as meat as well.
luxury.zh: 糖被认为是一种如此奢侈的东西，以至于他们也把它加到肉类等咸味菜肴中。
